items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 20 September 2026 6:05am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry with sunny spells to start then turning increasingly cloudy later in the day. Patchy outbreaks of rain or drizzle arriving late in the night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W 20-25, soon decreasing 15-20, then 10-15 in the afternoon, backing SW in the evening, increasing 15-20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong winds at first.
